description: BRACS cross-institutional held-out evaluation (Section 4.4), computed from logits/bracs_heldout/.
conclusion: Neither the accuracy gain nor the calibration behaviour survives cross-institutional shift. Fusion parameters are fitted on the in-distribution logits and applied to the held-out institutions.
correction_note: Earlier drafts reported 63.68% / +1.58 pp / ECE 0.160 for this experiment, taken from a stored result file rather than recomputed from the released test logits. Those values are superseded by the figures above, which are reproducible from this archive.
